Most developers use both an IDE and a CLI, but each solves a different problem. Cedric Clyburn and Legare Kerrison explain how IDEs, command-line tools, testing, pipelines, deployments, and infrastructure fit together in modern DevOps workflows. Learn why context switching often becomes a bigger bottleneck than writing code itself.
